name: novarouter
description: NovaRouter — AI gateway (FastAPI + Jinja2 UI). `bun run dev` starts the Python server; bun itself hosts only the NovaFree engine sidecar. The Root@Build terminal runs in-process by default and can be hosted on its own with `bun run terminal`.

scripts.lint: python3 -m compileall -q main.py nova routers ui terminal && echo lint-ok
